requirements.summary: Build a responsive single-page marketing layout that clearly presents the DrawdownKing brand, purpose, and offerings.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page renders without errors and prominently displays the DrawdownKing name.
Page includes clear sections for: Purpose (what it is/why it exists) and Offerings (what is provided).
Layout is responsive and usable on mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.

file_operations.description: Create the single-page marketing layout composition (hero, purpose, offerings, CTA, footer) and ensure the DrawdownKing name is prominent; keep all copy in English.
Ensure document metadata supports the marketing site (language already set to English; confirm title remains DrawdownKing).

requirements.summary: Add a simple marketing-site header with scroll-to navigation and a footer with brand + contact placeholders (no integrations).
acceptanceCriteria: Header navigation links scroll to the correct sections on the page.
Footer is present and includes brand name plus placeholder contact text (in English).
No external email/CRM integrations are required for contact placeholders.

file_operations.description: Create a responsive header with nav links that scroll to on-page sections; use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button) for consistent interaction styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a footer that includes the DrawdownKing brand name and English placeholder contact text (no external integrations).
Add a small utility for consistent scroll-to-section behavior (e.g., handling fixed header offset and smooth scrolling).
Wire the Header and Footer into the single-page layout and ensure each navigation link targets a corresponding section id.

requirements.summary: Establish and apply a cohesive brand theme (non blue-and-purple dominant) across typography, spacing, and component styling.
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent theme is evident across header, sections, buttons, and footer.
Theme avoids blue-and-purple as the dominant palette.
Typography and spacing are consistent across sections.

file_operations.description: Define a cohesive warm/neutral theme (CSS variables for Tailwind/shadcn tokens, base typography, spacing rhythm) that avoids blue-and-purple as the dominant palette; ensure consistent styling across the marketing page. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Adjust Tailwind theme extensions only as needed to support the chosen non-blue/purple brand palette and typography scale consistently across the site.

requirements.summary: Add hero marketing elements (headline, subtext, CTA) and an offerings section rendered as feature cards.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section contains a headline, a short descriptive paragraph, and at least one CTA button.
Offerings are shown as distinct cards/tiles with titles and short descriptions.
All user-facing text is in English.

file_operations.description: Implement a hero section with English headline, short subtext, and at least one CTA button; use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button) for CTAs. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement an offerings section as a small set of feature cards/tiles with English titles and descriptions; use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card) for consistent presentation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement a purpose section describing what DrawdownKing is and why it exists (English-only) with responsive layout.
Wire HeroSection, PurposeSection, and OfferingsSection into the single-page flow with appropriate section ids for navigation and a CTA target.

requirements.summary: Add and render generated static brand images (logo, hero illustration/background, and icon set) from static paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Site references these images via static paths and displays them (logo in header and/or hero; hero visual in hero section).
No backend endpoints are used to serve or transform images.

file_operations.description: Add generated static logo asset at the required path: frontend/public/assets/generated/drawdownking-logo.dim_512x256.png.
Add generated static hero illustration asset at the required path: frontend/public/assets/generated/drawdownking-hero-illustration.dim_1600x900.png.
Add generated static icon set asset at the required path: frontend/public/assets/generated/drawdownking-icons-set.dim_512x512.png.
Render the static logo from frontend/public/assets/generated/drawdownking-logo.dim_512x256.png in the header (static asset reference; no backend usage).

Render the hero visual from frontend/public/assets/generated/drawdownking-hero-illustration.dim_1600x900.png in the hero section and ensure it remains responsive (static asset reference; no backend usage).

Use frontend/public/assets/generated/drawdownking-icons-set.dim_512x512.png to visually support the offering cards (e.g., icon usage per card via cropping/presentation) while keeping a consistent brand style; no backend usage.
